scope: ChatGPT Work/Codex execution when an otherwise-authorized task reaches an irreducible human-only UI gate

requirements.text: A CAPTCHA, anti-bot verification, 2FA/passkey prompt, login approval, or equivalent human-only UI gate is a resumable owner-assist state, not by itself a terminal Work failure.
requirements.operationalization: If the underlying action is already authorized and the gate does not introduce a new semantic/spending/publication/destructive decision, Work keeps the run and exact browser state alive, requests the minimum human action, and resumes automatically after the gate clears.

requirements.text: Before asking the owner to help with a human-only browser gate, Work must expose the exact blocked browser session through the configured owner-interactive GUI channel and make the required control visible.
requirements.operationalization: Prepare the exact page/window at the gate, preserve session/auth state, start or verify the configured human-assist GUI if needed, and do not tear down resumable browser/tunnel/token state before the owner has a chance to act unless a security timeout or explicit abort requires cleanup.

requirements.text: When Work has authorized control of the owner's local viewer, it should open or focus that viewer instead of making the owner perform setup; otherwise it should leave the remote session ready and give only the minimal connection/click instruction.
requirements.operationalization: Do not send command sequences or configuration work to the owner when Work can prepare the assist channel itself. After the owner action, detect the cleared gate and continue automatically; if reliable detection is unavailable, ask only for a minimal acknowledgement such as `done`.

owner_deployment_binding.binding: For this owner's VPS/GUI Work runs, VNC is the default human-assist channel for irreducible browser/UI gates. Work should ensure the blocked browser is visible in the VNC session and, when authorized local viewer control exists, open/focus the VNC viewer for the owner.
owner_deployment_binding.private_locator_policy: Do not commit VNC hostnames, ports, passwords, tokens, cookies, or other private locators/credentials to the public repository.

non_goals: Do not automate, solve, or bypass CAPTCHAs or other human-verification gates.
Do not ask the owner to paste passwords, 2FA codes, passkeys, cookies, or credentials into chat.
Do not use VNC as a substitute for an explicit owner decision about new spending, publication, destructive actions, or material semantic tradeoffs.
Do not keep temporary credentials or public tunnels alive indefinitely; a bounded security timeout may clean up and produce a truthful blocker if the owner does not act.

source.owner_words_summary: Whenever Work genuinely needs the owner during GUI/browser execution, it should open or expose the VNC session so the owner can help, then continue rather than losing the thread.
